params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P2
Summary: On 16 November 2026 signing in on gentells.com failed for at least two accounts, one of them during a meeting with a prospect, so the product could not be shown. It works again, but the cause was never established, so it can return.

Source: Portal mail:62.

## What happened

- On 16 November 2026, in the afternoon (one failure is timed at about 16:36 CET), signing in on gentells.com did not work for at least two existing accounts. The Observatory and the Studio sign in through gentells.com, so they were out of reach as well.
- One of those accounts was being used to demonstrate Gentells to a prospect. Little could be shown.
- By the evening of the same day signing in worked again, without a change on our side that explains it.

## What is known

- The server answered sign-in requests correctly during the failure, as far as was checked at the time.
- Stale cookies in the browser were the working guess. It was not confirmed.

## What is asked

Find the cause and close it, or show that it cannot return:

- Read the application log and the web server log of gentells.com for 16 November 2026 between 15:00 and 19:00 CET: sign-in attempts, 419 (expired CSRF token) and 302 loops, session errors.
- Check what changed around that time: deploys, session or cookie settings (name, domain, SameSite, lifetime), the pre-launch gate and its preview cookie.
- Reproduce with an old session cookie and an old gate cookie in the browser.
- If stale cookies are the cause: make a sign-in with a stale cookie recover by itself instead of failing.
params.title: Signing in on gentells.com failed on 16 November 2026; cause not established
